hypothesis.statement: Raw readiness counts overstate independent observer failures because an unavailable provider is evaluated once per backend poll rather than once per completed 15-minute decision.
hypothesis.falsifier: The frozen route sequence contains multiple separate observer_status_stale episodes or an eligible signal attributable to the stale interval.

poll_normalized_episode_evidence.interpretation: The 245 stale rows are one continuous technical episode sampled repeatedly by the backend. They are not 245 independent missed market opportunities.

research_decision.next_diagnostic: Attribute the single stale interval to expected source/session availability versus an observer fault using source health and decision-journal continuity.
research_decision.reason: The corrected sampling semantics do not prove an eligible signal, loss, or strategy defect; they prevent technical polling frequency from distorting research priority.

limitations: Consecutive blocker episodes describe technical state continuity, not trade frequency or win probability.
This evidence does not establish whether the stale interval originated at the venue source, transport, or observer process.
Zero eligible signals in this prefix does not establish that the route will remain inactive.
